activity.overview: Listen to a short text about rain. Tell where rain comes from and where it goes.
activity.passage: Rain falls from the clouds. Some rain soaks into the ground. Plants drink it with their roots. Some rain runs down the street and makes puddles. When the sun comes out, it warms the puddles. Little by little, the water goes up into the air. The puddle gets smaller and smaller until it is gone!

questions.prompt: How do plants drink the rain?
What happens to a puddle when the sun comes out?
Draw rain falling on a plant.

activity.subject: science
activity.title: Where Does Rain Go?
